name: Akogare
source:
The last summer of school life approaches. The building gets empty. Oyukawa Shuichi never took studies seriously, but yesterday he went to an almost empty school with a serious intention. That's because he can finally convey his feelings to the teacher.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
校园生活的最后一个夏天即将到来，校舍里的人影日渐稀少。及川修一过去从未认真对待学业，但昨天，他怀着郑重的决心来到几乎空无一人的学校。因为他终于能够向老师传达自己的心意。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
